latHint: Think complaining loudly - not a porch railing.
pivHint: A porch has a sturdy RAIL - but to RAIL against something means to do what?
winText: Letting off steam. RAIL was the pivot - a porch RAILing to a loud GRIPE.
lossText: GRIPE - to RAIL and complain. RAIL was the pivot: porch RAILing to RAILing against something.
